title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He is currently receiving maintenance hemodialysis three times per week. He reports feeling well overall today, noting no significant shortness of breath or severe fatigue between sessions. He denies any recent infections or acute changes in his fluid status. He is compliant with his current renal diet and fluid restrictions.

Medication List
1. Erythropoietin alpha
2. Sevelamer
3. Phosphate binders
4. Vitamin D analogs

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Skin is intact with normal turgor. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Heart sounds are regular. No peripheral edema noted in lower extremities.

Assessment
1. ESRD on maintenance hemodialysis.

Plan
Continue current dialysis schedule. Monitor laboratory values including potassium, phosphorus, and hemoglobin. Patient will continue current medications and renal diet. Follow up in one month for routine evaluation.
explanations: ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.
Patient on dialysis: add Z99.2 dependence on renal dialysis.

distractors.why: Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
Dialysis status is reported with Z99.2.
